id./param/scenario/cs/c_020_cs_010.pack|cs_: "What a size...

"We were told to check it out, but...
  this is mind-blowing. What is
  that black thing...

"It gives off a sinister aura.
  It's certainly not holy...

"...Is that Erdwin's Lantern? We can't just
  leave it, but it's up in the sky,
  so there's nothing we can do.
"Luminary. You seem troubled.
"You're alive, Mordegon!

"I am Mordegon, you say?
  I see... To you, I appear
  as Mordegon.

"In your world, I am
  called the Seer.
"The Seer...?

"People imagine my form differently,
  so my appearance shifts
  to suit each one.
"...Still, this form must unsettle you.

"...I can see it.
  You riding Cetacea, the divine messenger,
  and meeting the people of the sky.

"Cetacea, the divine messenger? People of the
  sky? What is that?

"The sound of a legendary flute will guide you
  there... That is all I can say.

"H-hey, wait!
  I don't understand any of this!

"Little time remains.
  No time to dawdle.
  Now, go.

"A legendary flute? This is all
  I have... {var:1}, any ideas?

"Hmm... We have no other leads.
  Try playing it?
"A whale... flying in the sky!?
"Is that the divine messenger, Cetacea?

"You're not very surprised. The Seer,
  the flying whale... as if it's
  not your first time.

"...Hee hee, well, never mind.
  We'll follow you as always.

"Then let's go, {var:1}.
  We'll ride that flying whale
  to meet the people of the sky!
